what: The D1b street vignette as a flat list of primitives. Generated, never hand-edited: regenerate with `dotnet run -c Release --project ledger/CoreTests -- --write-vignette-pieces`. Both engines build from this so that every difference in a judged pair is a renderer difference.
quantisation_note: Every number is rounded to that many decimals, so a coordinate here is within 0.5 um of the unrounded plan Unity builds from. Deliberate: a byte-identical drift guard needs a fixed printed form, and 0.5 um is four orders below the thinnest piece in the scene.
